title: Duecare harness chat — wheels
subtitle: v3.17 omni harness chat: 5 toggles + 4 grade modes + 9 model variants
description: v3.17 / chat-package 0.3.2 (2026-05-07) — 21-dim rubric, use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance. v0.3.2 polish: AbortController-cancelled grade streams (closing the modal stops the server worker), mode-card disable while scoring (closes click-twice race), tooltips on every NOT-WIRED tile explaining why, harness-tile probing state ("…") so a first-time user doesn't see a wall of grey before /api/harness-info responds, mobile-responsive grade tables (overflow-x scroll), better-shaped /api/grade error messages (413 / 429 / 503 / 404 each get human-friendly text), client-side empty-response_text guard before scoring. Carries v0.3.1 Brave-aware harness-info, v0.3.0 Brave BYOK + keyboard shortcuts, v0.2.9 server-side import store + ZIP, v0.2.8 per-step SSE progress. GREP rule set now ships 111 rules across 16 categories, including v3.17 digital-era additions for QR/mobile-wallet payment plans, side-letter two-contract deception, and digital credential-vault debt control. RAG corpus now ships 35 docs, including digital fee collection and side-letter deception briefs. Bundled wheels: duecare-llm-chat, duecare-llm-core, duecare-llm-models. Single CORE entry point: one configurable interface wiring every harness layer + 9 model variants (Gemma 4 E2B / E4B / 26B-A4B / 31B / 2 abliterated jailbroken / 3 cloud BYOK routes). Updates land here - bump this dataset version to refresh attached notebooks.
